Relation classification (RC) is a crucial task in information extraction (IE), aiming to identify the relation between entities in a text.

We present an efficient and effective prompt method for multilingual RC (see Figure ) that derives prompts from relation triplets (see Section 3.1). The derived prompts include the original sentence and entities and are supposed to be filled with the relation label.
